messages.desktop.settings.localHistory.builtIns: Built-in rules, which also apply: {patterns}. Add a line such as `!**/target/` to record one of these folders again.
messages.desktop.settings.localHistory.regexHelp: One per line, case-insensitive, matched anywhere in the project-relative path with `/` separators, for example `^build/` or `(test|spec)/`.
messages.desktop.settings.localHistory.invalidLim: Enter the limit as a whole number of megabytes, 1 or more, or leave it empty for the default.
messages.desktop.settings.editor.tabLimitHelp: Opening a file past the limit closes another file tab. Tabs with unsaved changes, terminals and Agent conversations are never closed.
messages.desktop.settings.editor.tabPolicy: When the limit is reached, close
messages.desktop.viewer.externalHint: Lithe cannot show this kind of file. Open it in the system's default application.
messages.desktop.viewer.binaryHint: This file is not text. Its first bytes are shown in hex, read only.
messages.desktop.viewer.truncated: Only the first 64 KB are shown.
messages.desktop.settings.updates.title: Updates
messages.desktop.settings.updates.help: Lithe checks a signed release feed and installs the new version after you confirm. The current version stays in place until the new one starts.
messages.desktop.settings.updates.notConfigured: This build has no update feed. Install new versions from the release page.
messages.desktop.settings.updates.ready: Version {version} is downloaded and ready to install.
messages.desktop.updates.available: Lithe {version} is available. Open Settings > Updates to install it.
messages.desktop.memory.tooltip: Memory: {total} MB in total. Lithe {lithe} MB, language servers {lsp} MB, services {services} MB.
messages.desktop.memory.title: Memory
messages.desktop.memory.noProcesses: No language servers or plugin services are running.
messages.desktop.editorMenu.openInBrowserFailed: Could not open the file in the browser: {reason}
messages.desktop.projectOpen.newWindowFailed: Could not open the project in a new window: {reason}
messages.desktop.tags.createAt: The tag is put on commit {hash}.
messages.desktop.refs.mergeConfirm: Merge {branch} into the current branch. If Git stops at conflicts, the Commit tool window shows the merge until you continue or abort it.
messages.desktop.refs.rebaseConfirm: Replay the current branch onto {branch}. If Git stops at conflicts, the Commit tool window shows the rebase until you continue or abort it.
messages.desktop.refs.checkedOutAndRebased: Checked out {branch} and rebased it onto the previous branch
messages.desktop.refs.trackingStopped: {branch} no longer tracks a remote branch
messages.desktop.vcs.commitDirectly: Commits are sent to the repository right away; there is no separate push.
messages.desktop.settings.fontsEditHelp: Check the places to change in the list above, one or more. Changes here take effect when you click Save, and the checked places then share them; Revert drops unsaved changes. Run output includes the output of runs, builds and tests and the Git console.
messages.desktop.build.noDebugAdapter: The build provider's own plugin declares no debug adapter that can start a prepared program.
